0x187ab2d: Researcher[?f0]Argh!!! Either my eyes or this weather system has GOT to be broken!\pWhat on earth is going on here! Two fast-moving rain clouds dumping enormous amounts of rain, wandering all over Sinnoh?\pEven if you stuffed my head into a Wash Rotom and spun it three times, I couldn't picture a scene like this!
0x187abe3: Researcher[?f0]Are you a Trainer passing through? Quick, come look at this!\pThis constant, roaming patch of localized rain is clearly abnormal. We suspect a Pokémon is behind it.\pIt must be a cluster of Drifloon gathered together, or some Pokémon with the Prankster Ability using Rain Dance and then running around!\pIf you run into any strange rainfall on your travels, please help us investigate whether a Pokémon is causing mischief.\pDo you happen to have a news-search device? That gadget might help you find the latest spots where these anomalies occur.
0x187ad3a: Researcher[?f0]I'm counting on you! If you come across any abnormal rainfall on your travels,\pplease help us look into whether a Pokémon is up to mischief.
0x187ad98: Researcher[?f0]Oh? You've handled it already? But the abnormal weather doesn't seem to have gone away...\pWhat? The cause of this anomaly is actually the legendary Tornadus from the Unova region?!\pYes, that must be it! That explains why the anomaly is still going on.\pI've heard the legend of Unova's three cloud deities. Tornadus and Thundurus bring thunderstorms that ruin crops.\pSince Tornadus has appeared, the thunderstorms popping up everywhere must be caused by Thundurus.\pPlease, help stop it.
0x187aec2: Researcher[?f0]Is it all resolved? Thank you for your help! What a remarkable Trainer you are! The bizarre weather has vanished too.\pActually, that legend from Unova has a sequel.\pWhen the two Legendary Pokémon that maliciously bring storms and lightning run wild,\pthe last of the three cloud deities, Landorus, appears to stop them.\pSo people came to regard Landorus as the righteous god of the harvest, and built a shrine to pray for it to bring bountiful crops.
0x187afc5: Researcher[?f0]Two of the three legendary cloud deities have appeared in Sinnoh. Doesn't that mean the last one is somewhere nearby too...?\pAccording to the legend, if you carry the three cloud deities and pray near the shrine, you should be able to meet it.\pThe only place in Sinnoh that still has such a shrine must be that ancient little town...
0x187aae9: Researcher[?f0]What lovely weather. The climate's pleasant and the air is fresh. I'd better put in some extra effort too.
0x187b085: Researcher[?f0]Ah, it's you! Perfect timing! Take a look at this!
0x187b0ae: Researcher[?f0]In the old days, a Drifloon would show up around here every Friday.\pBut as the times changed, Drifloon spread all over the world,\pand they're no longer limited to appearing at a specific time or place.\pYet this one still only drifts around here on Friday nights.\pWe've always hoped a Trainer would take it along and travel all across Sinnoh with it.
0x187b189: Researcher[?f0]If you don't mind, would you take good care of it for us?
0x187b1ba: Researcher[?f0]Wonderful! Alongside such a strong Trainer, it's sure to be happy!
0x187b1f9: Researcher[?f0]I see. Well, if you change your mind, come find me again.
0x187b23d: Researcher[?f0]Oh, you're carrying too many Pokémon... There's no room to take it along...
0x187b26d: Researcher[?f0]The weather in Sinnoh is normal for now. Please take good care of that little one!

0x188e8e6: [FC0105][?85]We've discovered that the techniques of Toxic and Double Team never made it to the Galar region.\pShortly after that, the "Pokémon Battle Safety Act" was updated with a clause banning the use of the Toxic and Double Team TMs.\pDouble Team aside, having Toxic available to just about everyone really isn't good for public safety. If anything, this law was updated a bit too late.\pBut for the sake of keeping this world in balance, I intend to seek out the person hit hardest by the new rules, Acerola of the Elite Four, to discuss a new path forward for the Iga ninja style and lend my help.\pI hear she has already gone off to prepare for the World Championships.[?86]\p--by -Gengyi Xiang-
0x188ea57: [FC0105][?85]After the temple of the phantom earthbound god Crimson Nova, sealed away at the ancient Maya ruins, collapsed,\pCrimson Nova, whom the world feared under the name of the Crimson Demon, was freed from the shackles that bound it.\pBut because its power had been greatly weakened for reasons unknown, even after gaining its freedom, Crimson Nova could no longer bring harm to the human world.\pInstead, it roams the world, giving humans trials and granting them power, making them members of the Crimson Demon clan.\pAccording to eyewitness accounts, none of them has ever seen the Crimson Demon directly,\pbut they all saw a Flareon engulfed in flames that called itself the Crimson Apostle, and every sighting was near lava.\pThough the Crimson Demon's vigor is not what it once was, and it has shown no clear signs of attacking humans in recent years, there haven't even been the classic cases of failed challengers vanishing on the spot,\pthis does not mean the human world is free of any threat.\pOn this point, I must go and make contact with them.[?86]\p--by -Gengyi Xiang-\p[FC0101]...\pThe signed date was left at two years ago.
0x188edc6: [FC0105][?85]The criminal syndicates are stirring beneath the surface.\pWhen they merge into one, that will be the day the countdown to the end begins to tick.[?86]\p--by -Gengyi Xiang-
0x188ee1a: [FC0105][?85]Our team's technical backbone, Counterclockwise, quit the project for personal reasons. On top of that, Lipan has been out of contact for ages, and Potato Chip is swamped with his day job, so Hyper Emerald was facing the dilemma of being unable to sync in Gen 8 elements, falling completely behind the times.\pTo fill the gaps in the team, I had no choice but to step up and take over the roles once held by Counterclockwise and Lipan, teaching myself the relevant programming knowledge to help fix a mountain of bugs and improve the gameplay experience.\pNow the basic effects of all the Gen 8 moves, Abilities, items, and so on have been implemented by my own hand, and I've strengthened the battle AI to a top-tier level for the field.\pI've also added various special battle modes, streamlined the Pokémon-raising process, and simplified the use of HM moves outside of battle.\pThe game also has difficulty tiers to suit all kinds of players.\pThe World Championships will officially open in the future, fully under my direction.[?86]\p--by -Gengyi Xiang-
0x188df49: [FC0107][?85]A little gift for you, please accept it. Also, when you have time, come by the northeast corner of Steven's residence.[?86]
0x188c046: Waji[?f0]Think it's strange? Why don't I pull out a pile of Legendary Pokémon to show off a lavish lineup like everyone around here does?\pThese few Pokémon may often be overlooked. Maybe their base stats are low and their looks are plain, but they mean something special to me.\pThey were my very first partners when I started battling, staying by my side through countless days and nights of battles as I gradually came to understand this sport.\pThat first bond can never be severed. Even after new systems like Z-Moves and Dynamax came out and they could no longer keep up with the metagame, I'm still willing to keep battling alongside them.\pI hope you, too, will never forget your original spirit, and always remember the joy Pokémon first brought you.\pAs long as you believe in your Pokémon, they will answer your hopes.\pThe gathered stars become one, and the bond will light up the future, becoming a path of brilliant, shining light!
